content: {"episode_id":"ep-05004","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered because the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (G45.9, Z86.73). The monitoring is required to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with the patient's symptoms. These findings are documented in the clinical indication note submitted with this appeal, and the correlation is needed to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management."}
